source: The components are stacked through-thickness, exactly as ARCH_Z1 stacks them in the substrate power layers and ARCH_Z2 stacks them in its backside layer. This is the only construction the framework's own converter model describes, and it keeps the three architectures comparable.

A real monolithic power die would place its components SIDE BY SIDE, so the stack height would be set by the tallest part rather than by the sum. No source in this repository describes such a die, and adopting it would also change the required footprint, which the converter area model does not currently support. It is carried as the lower bound of a two-point geometry sweep so the Z4 conclusion can be tested for robustness across the construction question rather than resting on one choice.
